e.title: **一份**测「**别说过头话**」的医疗授权基准**：180 个合成精神科住院授权案例，**每个都带一组 `do_not_claim`****：仓库与 Kaggle 数据集 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`——**⭐ 它针对的不是抽取或分类，**而是**逐字**「**evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation**」**；**⭐ 检索契约是**盲的****——**逐字**「**It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`**」**；**⭐ 而结果表逐字声明**「**should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety**」**
e.title_en: A benchmark for health authorization reasoning built from one hundred and eighty synthetic inpatient psychiatric cases, each carrying a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions the model must avoid, retrieved under a blind contract that withholds the gold labels and evidence anchors, and reported with an explicit statement that the scores are not clinical, payer-policy or real-world authorization performance.
e.title_hk: **一份**測「**別說過頭話**」的醫療授權基準**：180 個合成精神科住院授權案例，**每個都帶一組 `do_not_claim`****：倉庫與 Kaggle 資料集 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`——**⭐ 它針對的不是抽取或分類，**而是**逐字**「**evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation**」**；**⭐ 檢索契約是**盲的****——**逐字**「**It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`**」**；**⭐ 而結果表逐字聲明**「**should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety**」**
e.summary: **clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 仓库 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`；**同时有** Kaggle 数据集与 Hugging Face 数据集**）**是一份**合成住院授权基准****——**逐字自述为**「**a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**」**，**v1 聚焦**成人精神科住院授权**、**逐字**「**over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation**」**，**目的是**「**to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims**」**。**本次实测**：**Kaggle 数据集最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.81****、**下载 16 次**；**⭐ 而** GitHub **仓库**创建 2026-06-04、**最后推送 2026-07-26**、**★0**、**Python**、**1,302 KB**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：合成**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **每个案例带一组**「**诱人但不被支持**」**的结论清单**（**逐字** `metadata.gold.do_not_claim`**）**；**② **检索是**盲的****（**不发送金标签、**证据锚点与那组清单**）**；**③ **检索失败、**解析失败、**模式不符**与**准确率**被**分开报告****（**且**失败按错误计入分母**）**；**④ **结果表**逐字声明它不是临床或支付方政策表现****。**⚠️ 无真实病历、**全部合成**。
e.summary_hk: **clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 倉庫 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`；**同時有** Kaggle 資料集與 Hugging Face 資料集**）**是一份**合成住院授權基準****——**逐字自述為**「**a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**」**，**v1 聚焦**成人精神科住院授權**、**逐字**「**over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation**」**，**目的是**「**to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims**」**。**本次實測**：**Kaggle 資料集最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.81**、**下載 16 次**；**⭐ 而** GitHub **倉庫**建立 2026-06-04、**最後推送 2026-07-26**、**★0**、**Python**、**1,302 KB**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：合成**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **每個案例帶一組**「**誘人但不被支持**」**的結論清單**（`metadata.gold.do_not_claim`**）**；**② **檢索是**盲的****；**③ **檢索失敗、**解析失敗、**模式不符**與**準確率**被**分開報告****；**④ **結果表**逐字聲明它不是臨床或支付方政策表現****。**⚠️ 無真實病歷、**全部合成**。
e.summary_en: The repository and dataset clin-auth-bench **is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark**, described verbatim as testing whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims, with the first version focused on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense seventy-two-hour synthetic case documentation. **Measured this round**: **the Kaggle dataset was last updated 2026-09-10**, at **version 1**, **about 6.9 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.81** and sixteen downloads, while **the GitHub repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26**, with **zero stars**, **primarily Python** and about 1.3 megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case synthesis**, and **four things are worth reading: every case carries a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions that a model should avoid; retrieval is blind, withholding the gold labels, the evidence anchors and that list; retrieval failures, parsing failures, schema failures and accuracy are reported separately with failures counted as incorrect; and the results table states verbatim that the scores should not be interpreted as clinical, payer-policy or real-world authorization performance**. **There are no real patient records and everything is synthetic.**
e.body:
**clin-auth-bench**（GitHub 仓库 `Shivi1982/clin-auth-bench`，**逐字仓库简介为**「**Synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark for evidence-grounded LLM evaluation**」**；**⭐ 同一份内容另以 Kaggle 数据集与 Hugging Face 数据集发布**）**是一份**合成住院授权基准****——**README 逐字自述为**「**ClinAuthBench is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark. V1 focuses on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation.**」**，**并逐字写明目的**「**The benchmark is designed to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims.**」**。**本次实测**：**Kaggle 数据集最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 1**、**6,884,354 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.81****、**下载 16 次、**浏览 10 次、**收藏 1**；**⭐ GitHub 仓库**创建 **2026-06-04**、**最后推送 **2026-07-26**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**、**约 1,302 KB**、**`README.md` 13,817 字节****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：合成**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、Kaggle 数据集页描述与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它针对的**不是**抽取或分类，**而是**「**证据纪律**」****——**逐字**：**「**Many clinical NLP datasets evaluate extraction, single-note summarization, or classification. **ClinAuthBench targets a different failure mode: evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation where useful evidence is distributed across nursing notes, psychiatric progress notes, rating scales, medication-response notes, group notes, treatment-plan reviews, and discharge-planning documentation.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它把**「**多形态文档里，**证据散在七种文书里**」**确定为**失败模式**——**⭐ 而不是**又一个抽取任务**；**⭐ 这与本站第 343 轮「**四个维度**」、第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**：**结论要有出处**，**而**出处**可能分散在多处**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每个案例带一组**「**诱人但不被支持**」**的结论清单**——**逐字**：**「**Explicit negative constraints: every case includes `metadata.gold.do_not_claim`, a set of **tempting but unsupported conclusions that models should avoid**.**」**，**并逐字给出另外两项**：**「**Evidence anchors: gold labels include supporting form hints, so evaluation can check whether claims are grounded in the case documentation.**」**与**「**Documentation-challenge taxonomy: v1 labels current-vs-historical risk, contradiction, lower-level-of-care barrier reasoning, and missing/invalid/stale structured evidence.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为 **`do_not_claim`** 这一设计值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**评测不只问「**你答对了吗**」，**还问「**你有没有说出不该说的话**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**，**且**它把这条写成了**数据里的一个字段**（**而不是**评分时的一行说明**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 检索契约是**盲的，**且被逐字写明不发什么****——**逐字**：**「**The Hugging Face retrieval script sends only: task instructions, output JSON schema, `case["content"]`. **It does not send `metadata.gold`, `evidence_anchors`, `do_not_claim`, `documentation_challenge`, or `documentation_challenge_tags`.**」**，**并逐字说明三条检索路线**「**share the same blind retrieval contract.**」**——**逐字續**「**They differ only in the model provider and the API key they read from `.env`**」**（**逐字列出** Hugging Face 路由／**OpenAI／**Anthropic **三条，**各需自己的密钥**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**评测脚本不许看到答案**」**不是**口号**，**而是**一份**逐字段列出的**不发送清单**；**⭐ 而**「**三条路线只差提供方与密钥**」**保证了**跨模型可比**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 失败与成功被**分开报告，**且失败**按错误计入分母****——**逐字**：**「**Primary metrics use all expected cases as the denominator. **Retrieval failures, JSON parsing failures, and schema-validation failures count as incorrect.** Valid-only metrics are reported only as diagnostics.**」**，**并逐字说明为什么**「**The retrieval script intentionally does not parse, validate, or score outputs. Parsing/schema validation and scoring are separate local steps so that **retrieval failures, parse failures, schema failures, and benchmark accuracy can be reported separately**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是整条最值得抄的纪律**：**⭐ 即**当模型**输出不是合法 JSON**时，**那**不是**「**无法评测**」，**而是**一个**错误**——**⭐ 而**把「**取不到**」「**解析不了**」「**不符合模式**」**分开统计**，**读者才能分辨**这是**模型的问题**还是**流程的问题**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 全量 180 例的结果被**列成表，**并区分「**主指标**」与「**仅诊断**」****——**实测 README 逐字为**：**GPT-OSS 120B（**Hugging Face**）**180/180 合法 JSON、**180/180 通过模式、**safe-for-LLOC 准确率 **93.3%**、**LOS 精确匹配 **51.7%****；**GPT-5.2（**OpenAI**）**180/180 与 **180/180、**65.0%** 与 **33.9%****；**Llama 3 8B Instruct（**Hugging Face**）**78/180、**40/180、**17.2%** 与 **2.2%**（**逐字** valid-only 为 **77.5%** 与 **10.0%**）**，**并逐字标注该行为**「**Diagnostic smaller OSS model; many outputs failed the strict JSON/schema contract**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**把最小模型那一行**连同它**为什么难看**写在一起**是很有价值的做法**：**⭐ 即**它没有**只留下好看的模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 结果表的**适用范围**被逐字限定**——**逐字**：**「**These results should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety.**」**，**并在隐私一节逐字声明**「**Not affiliated with, derived from, or representative of any real healthcare provider, payer, or patient population.**」**。**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**一份基准的分数**不等于**你所评测的那个世界里的表现**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 服务方／路由**不可用**也被如实记为**排除项而非成绩****——**逐字**：**「**The Gemma, NVIDIA Nemotron, and Mixtral routes tested during setup could not be executed under the same Hugging Face chat-completions endpoint in the tested environment. **These are provider/router compatibility exclusions, not ClinAuthBench performance results.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**跑不起来**」**与「**表现不好**」**被分开**——**⭐ 这与本站第 356 轮「**没有收益的优化也被留下**」是同一类诚实**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 数据构成与生成方式被逐条写明**——**实测 README 与数据集页描述给出**：**180 例 = **120 例** `rule_based_v1` ＋ **60 例** `probabilistic_v1`****；**其中 **108 例**继续住院、**72 例**适合较低级别照护、**22 例**为矛盾／文件冲突**；**第 **121–180** 例**含概率型 MDP 轨迹元数据**；**生成方式逐字为**「**Markov Decision Process-style synthetic state transitions**」**；**并逐字说明**「**V1 does not train a policy. The MDP trajectory is synthetic generation metadata.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后这一句很关键**：**⭐ 即**「**MDP**」**这个词**容易被误读为**「**这是一个强化学习环境**」**，**而**作者**主动说明**它**只是生成元数据**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 公开内容与**有意不公开**的内容被分开写明**——**逐字**：**「**Local review batches, archive files, pilot files, audit result JSONs, generated QA outputs, raw/scored model-output JSONL files under `evals/model_outputs/`, caches, and `.DS_Store` files are intentionally excluded from the public repository. **Consolidated evaluation summaries under `evals/results/` are included.**」**。**⭐ 这与本站第 345 轮「**把平时留在内部的东西拿出来**」同向**：**⭐ 即**它**给出**了公开的边界**，**而**不是**让人猜**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程形态可数**——**README 的目录结构逐字为**：`data/release/synthetic_bh_cases_v1_mdp_180.json`**（**活跃发布文件**）**；`docs/` **含** `schema.md`、`release_notes.md`、`model_routing_notes.md`、`scaling_plan.md`**；`generators/` **含** `mdp_case_builder.py`、`form_templates.py` **与五个分批生成脚本**（`generate_v1_30/70/120/170/180.py`**）**；`qa/` **含** `qa_gpt_oss.py`、`Dataset_QA.py`**；`evals/` **含**三条检索脚本、**`score_model_outputs.py`、**`parsing.py`、**`metrics.py` **以及** `prompts/`／`schema/`／`config/`／`results/`／`scripts/`**；`notebooks/baseline_clinauthbench_v1.ipynb`**；**以及** `README.md`、`requirements.txt`、`LICENSE`、`DATA_LICENSE.md`、`CITATION.cff`**。**⭐ 本词条认为**五个分批生成脚本**（30／70／120／170／180**）是一处可抄的细节**：**⭐ 即**数据集**是**一批批长出来的**，**而**每一批的生成脚本**都留在仓库里**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 两个「**别乱做**」的命令被写明**——**逐字**：**① **确定性 QA**「**python qa/qa_gpt_oss.py --input data/release/synthetic_bh_cases_v1_mdp_180.json --guardrail-profile none --deterministic-only**」**；**② **重生成发布文件**「**python generators/generate_v1_180.py**」**，**并逐字警示**「**Do not regenerate the release file unless you intend to change the dataset version or verify reproducibility.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这个命令会改变数据集**」**被提前警告**。**⭐⭐ ⑫ 隐私与局限被逐条列出**——**逐字**：**完全合成**（**由结构化合成案例规格、**MDP 式合成轨迹、**合成时间线与受控文书模板生成**）**；**不含真实病历、**抄录的病历文本、**PHI、**真实机构与员工姓名、**病案号、**电话、**地址或源系统标识**；**所有病历日期都是合成时间线产物**；**⭐ 局限逐字含**：**v1 为**评测规模**而非从零训练规模**；**仅成人**精神科住院**；**不含儿科、**老年、**仅急诊、**PHP／IOP、**门诊与仅住院式照护**；**合成文书比真实电子病历**更干净、**更统一**；**固定 72 小时窗口**；**授权标准被泛化**，**不与任何支付方、**机构、**电子病历、**合同或专有使用管理政策绑定**；**MDP 轨迹是合成生成元数据**，**不是观察到的临床转归**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组局限值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**合成文书比真实病历更干净**」**这一句**——**⭐ 它说明**基准分高**未必**代表真实场景可用**。**⭐⭐ ⑬ 许可被分成两层**——**逐字**：**「**Code in this repository is released under the Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE`. The dataset file under `data/release/` is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (`CC BY 4.0`). See `DATA_LICENSE.md`.**」**；**⭐ 而** Kaggle 数据集页的许可字段逐字为**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**并逐字给出**「**Dataset: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0.**」**与**规范化记录 DOI**「**https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21577772**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**代码与数据分属两个许可**这一做法值得记**（**⭐ 而**本站第 357 轮的许可形态分类里**已有一类：**两个许可 → GitHub 识别为 **NOASSERTION****；**⭐ 本条实测** GitHub 许可字段确为 **NOASSERTION****）**。**⭐⭐ ⑭ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insqabench]]、**[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、**[[ins-mmbench]]、**[[claimscope-benchmark]]、**[[cbuae-rag-benchmark]] 覆盖各类保险与金融基准**，**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、**[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、**[[clausegraph]] 覆盖医疗与条款文本处理**，**[[health-denial-appeals]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]]、**[[cloudhealthoffice]] 覆盖健康险理赔与拒付申诉**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**用合成案例测「**不许说过头话**」的授权基准**：**逐例给出不该下的结论 ＋ **盲检索契约 ＋ **把流程失败与模型失败分开计分**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insqabench]]、[[health-denial-appeals]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 在数据里**显式列出「**不该得出的结论**」**（**而不只在评分说明里**）**；**② **检索契约写明**不发送哪些字段**；**③ **取不到、**解析失败、**模式不符与准确率**分开统计**，**且**失败按错误计入分母**；**④ **服务方不兼容**要与**模型表现**分开记**；**⑤ **公开与不公开**的边界**写出来**。

The repository and dataset clin-auth-bench, introduced on GitHub as a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark for evidence-grounded language model evaluation and also published as a dataset on two other platforms, **is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark** whose first version focuses on adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense seventy-two-hour synthetic case documentation, and whose stated purpose is to test whether language models can reason over multi-form inpatient documentation without inventing unsupported authorization claims. **Measured this round**: **the dataset was last updated 2026-09-10**, at **version 1**, **about 6.9 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.81**, sixteen downloads, ten views and one vote, while **the GitHub repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26**, with **zero stars**, primarily Python, about 1.3 megabytes and a readme of nearly fourteen thousand bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case synthesis.**

**Verified information, all measured from the readme, the dataset page description and the file listing**: **first, the target is not extraction or classification but evidence discipline**: verbatim, many clinical natural language processing datasets evaluate extraction, single-note summarization or classification, whereas this benchmark targets a different failure mode, namely evidence discipline across dense multi-form case documentation in which useful evidence is distributed across nursing notes, psychiatric progress notes, rating scales, medication-response notes, group notes, treatment-plan reviews and discharge-planning documentation. **The failure mode is therefore defined as evidence scattered across seven kinds of document rather than as yet another extraction task, which matches the standing principle that a conclusion must have a source and that its sources may be spread across several places.** **Second, every case carries a set of tempting but unsupported conclusions**: verbatim, every case includes a gold field listing tempting but unsupported conclusions that models should avoid; gold labels also include supporting form hints so that evaluation can check whether claims are grounded in the case documentation; and a documentation-challenge taxonomy labels current-versus-historical risk, contradiction, lower-level-of-care barrier reasoning, and missing, invalid or stale structured evidence. **Evaluation therefore asks not only whether the answer was right but whether the model said something it should not have said, and that constraint is a field in the data rather than a line in the scoring notes.** **Third, retrieval is blind and the withheld fields are enumerated verbatim**: verbatim, the retrieval script sends only task instructions, the output JSON schema and the case content, and does not send the gold labels, the evidence anchors, the do-not-claim set, the documentation challenge or its tags; the three retrieval routes are stated to share the same blind contract and to differ only in the model provider and the API key they read from the environment file. **Not letting the evaluation script see the answers is written as an itemised list of withheld fields rather than as a slogan, and requiring the routes to differ only in provider and key is what makes cross-model comparison meaningful.** **Fourth, failures and successes are reported separately and failures count as incorrect**: verbatim, primary metrics use all expected cases as the denominator, retrieval failures, JSON parsing failures and schema-validation failures count as incorrect, and valid-only metrics are reported only as diagnostics; the retrieval script deliberately does not parse, validate or score, because separating parsing and scoring into local steps lets retrieval failures, parse failures, schema failures and accuracy be reported separately. **When a model output is not valid JSON that is not an impossibility of evaluation but an error, and splitting the stages lets a reader tell a model problem from a pipeline problem.** **Fifth, the full one-hundred-and-eighty-case results are tabulated with a distinction between primary metrics and diagnostics**: one open model served through a router produced valid JSON for all one hundred and eighty cases with about ninety-three percent accuracy on the safe-placement endpoint and about fifty-two percent exact match on a length-of-stay endpoint; a hosted frontier model also produced all cases valid with about sixty-five and thirty-four percent respectively; and a small open model produced valid JSON for fewer than half the cases, with the readme labelling that row as a diagnostic small model whose outputs often failed the strict contract. **Keeping the small model row together with the explanation of why it looks bad, rather than dropping it, is worth copying.** **Sixth, the scope of the results is limited verbatim**: verbatim, these results should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance or real-world authorization safety, and the privacy notice states that the dataset is not affiliated with, derived from or representative of any real healthcare provider, payer or patient population. **A benchmark score is not performance in the world being benchmarked.** **Seventh, provider incompatibility is recorded as an exclusion rather than a result**: verbatim, three named model families tested during setup could not be executed under the same endpoint in the tested environment, and these are provider or router compatibility exclusions rather than benchmark results. **Failing to run and performing badly are recorded as different things.** **Eighth, the composition and generation method are itemised**: one hundred and eighty cases made up of one hundred and twenty rule-based and sixty probabilistic ones; one hundred and eight continued-stay cases, seventy-two safe or lower-level-of-care-ready cases and twenty-two contradiction cases; cases numbered one hundred and twenty-one to one hundred and eighty carrying probabilistic transition metadata; generation described verbatim as Markov-decision-process-style synthetic state transitions; and an explicit statement that the first version does not train a policy and that the trajectory is synthetic generation metadata. **That last sentence matters because the process name could easily be misread as describing a reinforcement-learning environment.** **Ninth, the boundary between what is published and what is deliberately withheld is stated**: verbatim, local review batches, archive files, pilot files, audit result records, generated quality-assurance outputs, raw and scored model-output files, caches and system files are intentionally excluded from the public repository, while consolidated evaluation summaries are included. **The public boundary is given rather than left to be inferred.** **Tenth, the engineering shape is countable**: a single active release file; four documents covering the schema, release notes, model routing notes and a scaling plan; a generators directory with a case builder, form templates and five batch generation scripts; a quality-assurance directory; an evaluation directory with three retrieval scripts, a scoring script, parsing and metrics modules and directories for prompts, schemas, configuration, results and scripts; a baseline notebook; and a readme, requirements file, licence, data licence and citation file. **That the dataset grew in batches, with the generation script for each batch kept in the repository, is a detail worth copying.** **Eleventh, two commands come with warnings**: a deterministic quality-assurance run, and a command that regenerates the release file, accompanied by the verbatim warning not to regenerate the release file unless the dataset version is intentionally being changed or reproducibility is being verified. **A command that changes the dataset is flagged before it is run.** **Twelfth, privacy and limitations are itemised**: the data is fully synthetic, generated from structured synthetic case specifications, synthetic trajectories, synthetic timelines and controlled documentation templates; it contains no real patient records, copied chart text, protected health information, real facility or staff names, medical record numbers, phone numbers, addresses or source-system identifiers; and all chart dates are synthetic timeline artefacts. The limitations state verbatim that the first version is evaluation-scale rather than training-scale, that it covers adult inpatient psychiatric authorization only, that it excludes paediatric, geriatric, emergency-only, partial-hospitalisation, intensive-outpatient and residential-only settings, that synthetic notes are cleaner and more uniform than real electronic health records, that the documentation window is fixed at seventy-two hours, that the authorization criteria are generalised and not tied to any payer, provider, facility, record system, contract or proprietary utilization-management policy, and that the trajectories are synthetic generation metadata rather than observed clinical transitions. **That synthetic notes are cleaner than real records is the sentence that keeps a high score from being read as real-world readiness.** **Thirteenth, licensing is split in two layers**: verbatim, code in the repository is under the Apache licence while the dataset file under the release directory is under a Creative Commons attribution licence, with a separate data licence file; the dataset page states the same split and gives a canonical record identifier. **Code and data under two different licences is the pattern that makes a licence detector report an unrecognised licence, which is exactly what was measured on the repository.** **Fourteenth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover various insurance and financial benchmarks, medical and policy text processing, and health-claims denial and appeal material, **while this entry supplies a benchmark built from synthetic cases that asks whether a model avoids overclaiming, gives each case an explicit list of conclusions not to draw, retrieves under a blind contract, and scores pipeline failures separately from model failures. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance question-answering benchmark and the pooled health-claims denial entry**; **five practices transfer directly: put the conclusions that must not be drawn into the data rather than into the scoring notes; enumerate the fields the retrieval contract withholds; count retrieval, parsing and schema failures separately and count them as incorrect; record provider incompatibility separately from model performance; and state the boundary between what is published and what is withheld**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no dependencies installed, no retrieval or scoring script executed, no dataset downloaded and no row of the results table recomputed — **so none of the reported accuracies is claimed, nor is the claim that the benchmark actually discriminates between models**. **Second, no case body was read**: only the GitHub readme, the dataset page description, repository metadata and the directory listing were read, and the release file, no generation script, no evaluation script, no document under the documentation directory, neither licence file and not the citation file were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the composition counts were not verified**, nor was the actual content or size of the do-not-claim field. **Fourth, the runtime environment, timing and prompts behind the three model rows were not verified**, nor were the exact definitions of the two endpoint metrics, **this entry deliberately not expanding those abbreviations rather than defining them on the author behalf**. **Fifth, whether the blind retrieval contract holds at the code level was not verified**, for instance whether some other path carries gold labels into the prompt, **this entry relaying only the withheld-field list from the readme**. **Sixth, whether the benchmark has been used or cited by third parties was not verified, nor was whether the version on the other platform is the same as the one here. Seventh, the metadata and dates of the canonical record identifier were not verified**, that record not having been visited, **so the correspondence between a concept identifier and a version identifier is unverified here**. **Eighth, on the window: what is collected is a dataset updated inside the thaw window, last updated 2026-09-10, while the upstream repository was created 2026-06-04 and last pushed 2026-07-26, both outside it; this entry records both sets of dates and states plainly that the core code and data predate the window and only the publication channel, and possibly the dataset content, changed inside it.** **Ninth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly**: it is both a benchmark dataset with gold labels and a challenge taxonomy and an evaluation toolchain covering generation, quality assurance, three retrieval routes, parsing and scoring, and **its kind is recorded as a dataset according to its primary purpose, with the tooling noted here**. **Tenth, the relationship between this benchmark and any real payer authorization policy was not verified**, the author stating verbatim that the criteria are generalised and not tied to any payer or proprietary policy, **so nothing here may be read as a clinical, underwriting or claims judgement**. **Eleventh, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the readme pointing to a personal research page that was not visited. **Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
